newPatches.name: New clearing
newPatches.note: Dense invasives offer a large return. Without planting, they grow back into the cleared ground.

newPatches.name: Edge growth
newPatches.note: Invasives are spreading along an opening. Removal leaves open ground but no new native trees.

candidates.name: Mixed growth
candidates.note: Dense invasives grow between native stems. Removal would damage some of those stems.

candidates.name: Open ground
candidates.note: An old opening has few native stems. Dry grass covers the ground.

candidates.name: Narrow link
candidates.note: A small invasive patch joins dry ground to the forest farther north.
